stories.headline: HTC Vive Eagle is $349.99 in Black Friday — the Ray-Ban Meta rival at $150 off
stories.subtitle: HTC's camera-and-audio glasses — the first real Ray-Ban Meta rival at $499 — are $349.99 at HTC's store and Amazon in the Black Friday sale. 12MP camera, open-ear audio, and a $49 clip-on battery for customers who want an alternative to Meta.

stories.headline: Snap Specs start shipping — $2,195 true-AR glasses reach first buyers
stories.subtitle: Snap's Specs began shipping Nov 26 to preorder customers in the US, UK and France; new orders ship in early 2027. At $2,195 with the whole computer in the frame, it's the priciest display-glasses rival to the $799 Display.

stories.headline: Black Friday: rival AR glasses on sale — XREAL One Pro $499, RayNeo GT $249
stories.subtitle: Competitors are discounting too: XREAL's One Pro is $499 (from $599) and RayNeo's GT is $249 through Nov 30, with Rokid's AI Glasses Style at $279. Expect price-comparison questions — Meta's own sale leaves Gen 3 and the Display at full price.

stories.headline: Steam Frame is now the 5th most used PC VR headset
stories.subtitle: Valve's Steam Frame hit 5.49% of PC VR headsets in October's Steam survey — fifth overall after one full month on sale, ahead of Pico 4. Quest 3 still leads at 27%. Expect customers comparing the Frame to Quest to cite this.

stories.headline: Google's Android XR glasses go on sale Dec 10 — Warby Parker from $395
stories.subtitle: Google and Samsung's first Android XR glasses open for sale Dec 10: Warby Parker frames from $395, Gentle Monster from $449. They run Gemini with a 12MP camera and up to 9 hours of battery — and work with iPhone too. Gentle Monster's first batch already sold out.
